test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many artists are selected for the one-time Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**86**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Amrit Award 2022** was introduced as part of the celebration of India’s 75th year of independence under the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav initiative.
 
• A total of **86 artists**, aged above 75 years and who have not been recipients of any National Honour in their careers, were selected for this one-time award.
 
• The award aims to honor senior artists for their lifetime contribution to Indian performing arts, including music, dance, and theater.
 
• Recipients of the award were recognized for their dedication to preserving and propagating India's cultural heritage.
 
• The award was presented by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, the apex body for performing arts in India, functioning under the Ministry of Culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi:**

 
 
• Established in 1952, it is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• It functions as an autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture.
 
• The Akademi promotes, preserves, and documents India’s diverse performing arts heritage.
 
 
 
• **Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav:**
 
 
• A government initiative launched in March 2021 to commemorate 75 years of India’s independence.
 
• It focuses on celebrating India's cultural, historical, and developmental milestones.
 
• Activities under this initiative include awards, exhibitions, workshops, and cultural programs.
 
 
 
• **Performing Arts in India:**
 
 
• India has a rich tradition of performing arts, including classical dance forms like Bharatanatyam, Kathak, and Odissi.
 
• Classical music forms include Hindustani and Carnatic traditions, with numerous regional variations.
 
• Theater and folk performances like Yakshagana and Nautanki represent India's regional diversity.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Culture:**
 
 
• Responsible for the preservation and promotion of India’s cultural heritage.
 
• Oversees institutions like the Sangeet Natak Akademi, Lalit Kala Akademi, and National School of Drama.
 
• Organizes initiatives like the Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat program to foster cultural unity.
